subject: Re: Kythera security intake — CAIQ / SOC2 Q&A and evidence sprint
messages:
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@kythera.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: IT-Security <security@kythera.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ/SIG intake and first artifact request

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We reviewed Redwood's public materials and would like to start the formal intake for our SIG/CAIQ review. Two asks to get the ball rolling: 1) can we schedule a 45-minute intake call next week to walk the questionnaire and identify evidence owners; 2) please share any snapshot SOC2 summary (if available) and a short list of typical log sample formats you can provide (S3, syslog, app logs).

Attached is our preliminary questionnaire (kythera-sig-questionnaire-v1.xlsx) — it's annotated in the first tab with high-level scope. For the call, our preferred windows are Tue-Wed mornings (PDT).

Thanks — looking forward to aligning timelines.

Best,
Sofia Alvarez
Head of Security Programs
Kythera Therapeutics
Attachment: kythera-sig-questionnaire-v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@kythera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ/SIG intake and first artifact request

Hi Sofia — thanks for sending the questionnaire. We're available to run a 45-minute intake and triage evidence owners.

Proposed slots:
- Tue 2026-08-03 09:30-10:15 PDT
- Tue 2026-08-03 11:00-11:45 PDT
- Wed 2026-08-04 09:00-09:45 PDT

Marissa will own the CAIQ/SIG coordination and David will be the technical owner for logs. I attached a short intake packet with what we typically provide for a first pass (redwood-soc2-2025-summary.pdf).

Pre-call ask: can you confirm whether your scope needs production network captures or masked production logs only? That impacts the sample window we prepare. Also, do you need a signed NDA or is the HubSpot intake sufficient for now?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-soc2-2025-summary.pdf (pdf)

----
Neha Kapoor
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@kythera.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ/SIG intake and first artifact request

Hey team — I can take the intake call. Confirming David and I will own owner mapping and artifact delivery.

Quick notes for Sofia:
- Typical log samples we can provide: S3 export (parquet/csv), syslog (gz), application request logs (JSON).
- We usually supply a 24–72 hour window for initial samples; if you need longer retention ranges we can provide rolling exports but it adds prep time.
- For CAIQ fields that request architecture diagrams, I'll prepare an environment diagram and a short runbook for access controls.

If Tuesday 11:00 works, I'll send the calendar invite and attach an action tracker after the call.

Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@kythera.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, IT-Security <security@kythera.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ/SIG intake and first artifact request

Thanks — Tue 2026-08-03 11:00 PDT works for us (we'll use that slot). For samples, Kythera prefers masked production logs (no PCIs/PHI) and a 72-hour window if possible. We do have a lightweight NDA template; I've attached it for your legal to review. Also please include any SOC2 summary you can share on the call so our auditors can understand the testing period.

Attachment: kythera-nda-draft.docx (docx)

Sofia
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@kythera.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ/SIG intake and first artifact request

Thanks Sofia — noted on masked production logs and 72-hour window. Operational notes for the intake call:

- We can produce S3 exports of request logs in parquet or gzipped JSON. For masked samples we'll redact user identifiers and truncate request bodies where they may contain sensitive payloads.
- For network-level captures we do not provide full pcap exports by default; we can provide aggregated flow logs and firewall event excerpts.
- I'll prepare a manifest of the sample files and an example syslog export. See draft manifest attached.

Shared drive for artefacts (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2_CKythera-Intake

Attachment: log-sample-manifest.csv (csv)

-David
David Kim
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@kythera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T11:05:00-07:00

Perfect — calendar invite sent for Tue 11:00 PDT. Quick action items before the call:
- Kythera: confirm NDA route (Sofia) and any additional reviewers to include on the intake.
- Redwood: Marissa will share the CAIQ mapping template; David will stage 72-hour masked logs in the shared Drive for dry-run access.
- Neha: I'll prepare the action tracker and expected turnaround (we typically aim to have first tranche of artifacts within 5 business days post-intake).

Looking forward to the call.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
